description: Wreckage of the Rwandan presidential jet shot down on 6 April 1994 killing Presidents Juvenal Habyarimana and Cyprien Ntaryamira and triggering the genocide. The aircraft fell into the palace garden and the wreckage has been left in place at the rear of the compound and is presented to ticketed visitors as an exhibit of the Presidential Palace Museum. Recorded here as a curated memorial display rather than an in-situ crash site because the museum charges admission and interprets it. Some tour operators describe it as a Falcon 60 which is not a Dassault type.
